name: Camelia
source:
A maid working at the Shikinjou bathhouse.
She is a human-like doll created by [url=/c87444]Tsukuyomi[/url] and is [url=/c74517]Yosuga[/url]'s helper.
She functions thanks to the clockwork mechanism, so when the spring runs out, she stops moving and speaking.
She keeps a pet white mouse named [url=/c87714]Juliette[/url], who is [url=/c87712]Daifuku[/url]'s younger sister.
